data.name: Joseph
data.gender_notes: Joseph is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Joseph is recorded in name-lists as “He will add; God increases”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Joseph expresses “He will add; God increases”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Joseph total 28, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.

tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Yosef, from the root y-s-p, 'to add' (Genesis 30:24). Its root is Hebrew y-s-p. Joseph, son of Jacob; Joseph, husband of Mary. Joseph is a Hebrew name meaning “He will add; God increases”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
